subject: Geopolitics
title: Deepfakes and Trust Erosion
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Deepfakes and Trust Erosion.

hook.text: A deepfake video of Ukraine's Zelensky ordering surrender went viral in 2022. It was fake, but millions saw it first.

buildup.text: Deepfakes use AI to create realistic fake video and audio. They can put words in any leader's mouth convincingly.

discovery.text: The threat isn't just fake content — it's the erosion of trust. If anything can be faked, nothing can be believed.

twist.text: Real atrocities can now be dismissed as deepfakes. The technology provides cover for actual crimes.

climax.text: Detection tools exist but lag behind creation tools. The asymmetry favors those who create deception.

punchline.text: When everything can be faked, seeing is no longer believing.

quiz.question: What is the deeper strategic threat of deepfakes beyond false content?
options: They erode trust so that even real events can be dismissed as fake
They are too expensive for most nations to produce
